notes.title: -New game update-
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after I announced a few weeks ago that there would be a discontiunation of more games to come things have finally settled down with work. I will have the abillity to release another game. I am unsure of when the game will be done or when the game will be be put on steam. I am aiming for sometime between April-June of 2019.  Here are a list of questions you might have and my answers

Q: Is this game the one you began a few months ago?
A: No it's a brand new game

Q: What type of game is it? 
A:  It's a arena/dungeon crawl based game!

Q: How many classes and playable characters will there be?
A: 10! Yes 10 classes you can play as 4 at a time, but in battle you will be able to change out in battle. 

Q: Is there a story if it's a dungeon crawl based game?
A: Not really, this is more or less a game about just brawling with monsters, getting gold, valuable items, and gear!

Q: Can we expect there to be some sort of game in progress (beta) phase on steam?
A: Yes, I plan to soft release the game to steam to gather feed back.

Q: Is this game going to be free to play?
A: YES! SO MUCH YES! FOR SURE 100% YES! This game will be free to play!!!! I feel like as there is a lot of indie/rpg maker games that charge for money those that do are seasoned vetrans of indie/rpg maker making. I am still new to all of this so I won't be charging, also I can understand that money can be an issue for some people so I will make it free to play!

Q: Do we buy gear in this game?
A: Yes you can! But gear will also drop. There will be different tier sets of gear that will make you stronger!

Q: Will the classes require to be swapped out every battle?
A: Nope, classes will be diverse so they will be good/bad in some battles depends on play style as well!

For anymore questions please post them down below I hope to bring this game to you soon!

notes.title: Chapter 2 Patch (Journey to Sakio Post Patch)
notes.content:
Hello all, after doing some work on the final chapter in Journey to Luonto I have decided to make some changes to things in chapter 2 such as monsters/bosses stats such as armor and magic resit, boss spells, and so on. I plan to release the patch within the next hour or two and believe this will make chapter 2 more enjoyable

TDLR: Bosses: + new skills, Armor and Magic resit went down
Monsters Magic resit and armor went down
Useable weapons and armor : Armor and magic resit increased, Attack and Magic Attack increased 

These changes were needed for better balancing I hope these changes make the game better and smoother for you in chapter 2
 
As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live
notes.content:
Hello all,
As promised Patch 1.1 is now here and live
Lets get into whats new in 1.1!

1.Charecter Bios/profiles!: You can now learn all about each playable charecter and their life before coming to Rujino. To do so go to the menu, then go to
status and click on Profile (At the bottom)! 
2.My personal favorite thing that has come to patch 1.1 and the game in general! Statistics! Who doesn't love stats!
To acess the stasitics go to menu then go to status and click on statistics and they will show the following stats 
-Battles iniated
-Kills and Kills per battle
-Deaths and Deaths per battle
-Assists and Assists per battle
-Damage dealt
-Damage taken
-Healing preformed
-Healing recieved 
!!!!
3. General stats! More stats! to acess general stats for each charcter like the Stats and profiles go to the menu and click on 
status and go to general stats! In this tab you can find the following information
-level
-Max HP
-Max MP
-Attack
-Defense
-M. Attack
-M. Defense
-Agillity 
-Luck
-Current XP
-To next level XP
-Total XP for next lvl
4.This is a cool new added feature! The items tab in menu has a new interface and so do all shops through the game!
5.That thing in the top right? YES! 
You can now always see your quest and quest objective of the one you are currently on in the top right of the screen!
That means you don't always need to re open your quest log! The quest you are currently on and it's objective show in the top right on the screen

This patch was my favorite to roll out. I love everything that has been added to the game this patch and hope you enjoy it as well

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto!

notes.title: Patch 1.0 is live
notes.content:
Hi everyone the first thing is that there is a new patch! With this good news and bad news. 

The bad news, on my end it looks like my steam cloud save was deleted by steam I am unsure of what the cause is I would like to know if any of you are missing save data. I contacted steam dev support and notified them that my personal cloud saves are missing and hope to hear from them about this. If you lost any saves please let me know cloud based saves are enabled fully and I want to know if it's just on my end or if it's for a vast majoity of people. If you were affected save wise please contact steam support I can't look into it on my end and they can for you. 

So now that the bad stuff is out of the way lets get onto the patch it's self

So 1.0? Big patch right? Yes indeed it is 

Here is whats new:

Visual update charecter models for all charecters 

Updated Maps

some visual updates

updated dialouge 

New feature: You will be required to complete the current quest before acessing the next zone to prevent any confusion.

New feature: New monster roams the Luca. 


As Always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto

notes.title: DLC Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone I thank you for being patient while I work on the DLC. 

There are some things I would like to talk about with the DLC that you might have questions about or anything and will be talking a little bit about the story line lets get started
 
Some possible questions you might have:

Q: Are the charecters from the main game going to be the ones in the DLC or will we see new charecters?

A: Yes all the charecters you have fallen in love with will be featured in the DLC

Q: Is Trist getting a visual update?

A: Yes I plan on releasing a visual update of Trist in the next few days.

Q: Will the quest tracker be used in the DLC?

A: Yes the quest tracking system will remain in use, this way you can track quests with ease/

Q: Are there new spells?

A: As of right now I haven't put new spells in yet but they are planned, as far as how many I am unsure but I do plan on new spells/abillties for all of the charecters

Q: Will I get to keep the elven ancient spells that I learn right before I fight the boss who drops the statue of the bear?

A: No, sadly the anicent elven spells are a little over powered and this is something I want to avoid, however I do plan on giving each charecter a special abillity based on their background, so basically we are tweaking the spells of the elven ancestors and Liss and Viktor will get special abillities as well.

Q: Will we see any programs like the quest tracker. 

A: Yes I plan on making updates to things with some plugins to revamp the game in some ways

Q: How long will the DLC take to complete.

A: At this stage I am uncerntian of this and will have a better gauge of this when I get deeper into devlopment

Story line:

So where do I begin? At the start I guess

When you defeat Yuj you will be trasnported to a costal beach inside the inn there will be a inn keeper who I suggest you talk to. From there you will board a boat to Sakio where you will start off in a sea port town and get a quest from a retired Sakio guard from there ... the crazniess begins. 

You will face a great variety of bosses and new monsters. The quest will take you from Northren Sakio all the way south where the demon army that is currently on the door step of Sakio Castle in South Sakio. It's something you will have to play for you'r self to see it's very hard to explain all of it with out ruining it.

This is all I have for right now to share I will keep you all updated.

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto.

notes.title: Patch 0.2 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello everyone I apologize for the late update there have been fixes and some changes to the game.

The first thing is that in the quest journal text would be cut off making it hard to figure out what do to. Well that is fixed and you should be fully able to see the text

We also made some changes to specific monsters and their color altough a small change I felt that giving some of the charecters a fresh look would be a good idea

There are some updates to the first boss, the dragon. The dragons play style in combat has been revamped the dragon now uses a spell called dragons breath with this the dragon deals fire damage to all of your party members. This was needed because the boss seemed very easy and I will be looking over the other bosses and looking into making any changes that are needed. Not only is the dragon updated but castle Io has recieved a physical updated and is no longer a bland interior and I will be revamping all other boss layers that could use a fresher look. 

These changes are currently live in the patch and I am going to be looking into more ways I can improve the game!

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto! We are currently on the front page of new and trending RPG Maker Games and I thank all who have downloaded and played the game.

Not only is the dragon updated but castle Io has recieved a physical updated and is no longer a bland interior and I will be revamping all other boss layers that could use a fresher look. 

These changes are currently live in the patch and I am going to be looking into more ways I can improve the game!

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto! We are currently on the front page of new and trending RPG Maker Games and I thank all who have downloaded and played the game.

I am aware of a few bugs with you requiring to hit enter when ever you go to a ship in a port town well I believe I have a solution for it and will be rolling it into the 0.1 patch. As for the other update needed I am aware of the bug with the king in castle io not appearing after the dragon this is a simple fix and I will be making these changed tonight and hope to put out the new live build version. If you are experiencing any other issues let me know as far as the occasional 2-4 second lag I unfortunately can't do much about that since I an using RPG maker for the game so if you are looking to download the game you can play the updated version soon. Because this my first steam game I think to play the updated version you have to uninstall and re install if you already have it but you can copy paste your saved game data from current play through into the new games folder when you download it.
